title: TUI: review-queue mode — one-key approve/close of proposed issues
description: A queue view over the proposed list with a = approve, d = close (delete), applied in bulk (built on batch primitives from 0c580f95 so the CLI stays composable). Open SPEC question: is plain delete enough to 'close' a proposal, or is a rejected status warranted (r[review-command] would need extending).
